note: TBC1D32 variants causing Alsahan-Harris syndrome are strongly associated with pituitary malformation and hypopituitarism, contrasting with classic Joubert syndrome where pituitary anomalies are rare.

evidence.text: TBC1D32 is tied to Alsahan-Harris syndrome, with neuroimaging documenting anterior pituitary hypoplasia and ectopic posterior pituitary.

evidence.text: Joubert syndrome rarely presents with pituitary involvement such as multiple pituitary hormone deficiency, highlighting that pituitary abnormalities serve as a distinguishing feature.

source.title: Joubert syndrome with multiple pituitary hormone deficiency
source.quote: A few cases of JS with multiple pituitary hormone deficiency (MPHD) have been reported in literature. Here, we presented an unusual presentation of JS in a newborn with MPHD.
